Date : 15.03.2023 Heard Mr. R.P. Sarmah, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. D. Doley, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. K. Phukan, learned Central Government Counsel for the respondent no. 1; and Ms. M. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 3 &
4.
2.

It is projected that the petitioner no. 1 and the petitioner no. 2 are sons of one Banga Kasari @
Ranja Kasari.
The petitioner no. 3 is the grandson of Banga Kasari @ Ranja Kasari.

Banga Kasari @
Ranja Kasari was a recorded land holder/pattadar of a plot of land measuring 05 Bighas-04 Kathas-08 Lessas [5B- 4K-8L], covered by Dag no. 51 and periodic patta no. 116 [New], located at Mouza - Borgaon, Thelamara Revenue Circle, District - Sonitpur ['the subject- plot', for short].
3.

By a notice under Section 3[1] of the Petroleum and Mineral Pipeline [Acquisition of Right of User in Land] Act, 1962, a part of the subject-plot Page No.# 3/3 measuring 01 Bigha-01 Katha-14 Lessas [1B-1K-14L] has been acquired to exercise the Right of Use by the Central Government for laying of underground pipeline by the respondent no. 2 for transportation of natural gas in the State of Assam.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that in the notice issued under Section 3[1] [supra], the name of the recorded land holder/pattadar was mentioned as Ranga Kasari, son of Ginai whereas in the revenue records, the name was recorded as Banga Kasari.

Having not received the requisite complaints after acquisition of Right of Use over the part of the subject-plot measuring 01 Bigha- 01 Katha-14 Lessas [1B-1K-14L], the petitioners have approached this Court seeking inter alia a direction, more particularly, to the respondent no. 2 to release the compensation against the acquired plot of land.

As Ms. Phukan, learned Central Government Counsel has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1 and Ms. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 3 & 4, no formal notices need to be issued to the said respondents.

Mr. Doley, learned counsel for the petitioners shall, however, furnish requisite nos. of extra copy of the writ petition along with annexures, to Ms. Phukan and Ms.
Barman within 3 [three] working days from today.
6. The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 by registered post with A/D within 3 [three] working days from today.

Having not received the requisite complaints after acquisition of Right of Use over the part of the subject-plot measuring 01 Bigha- 01 Katha-14 Lessas [1B-1K-14L], the petitioners have approached this Court seeking inter alia a direction, more particularly, to the respondent no. 2 to release the compensation against the acquired plot of land.
